macro_news.source_note: Macro/geopolitical & policy news affecting Indian, US, EU and ASEAN stock/financial markets (war, conflict spillover, central-bank/rate commentary, policy moves), merged from one benchmark-index get_news feed per region and sorted by recency. Each item is tagged with the region whose feed surfaced it — not a claim that the story is exclusive to that region, since a single macro event (e.g. Middle East oil-price moves) routinely shows up across several regions' feeds independently, which is itself confirmation the event is genuinely cross-market.
